GLOBAL SPEC — STYLE: 3D DIORAMA TAROT STOP-MOTION & DYNAMIC PHOTO EVOLUTION
Cinematic 3D tactile miniature diorama set based on the Rider-Waite-Smith Tarot. Handcrafted 3D resin, clay, and heavy paper stop-motion figures and environments on a detailed mini stage. Studio lighting with dramatic rim light, volumetric shadows, rich saturated color palette, and subtle tilt-shift depth of field.

PHOTO & CARD EVOLUTION EFFECT:
Archival Rider-Waite-Smith tarot card illustrations and historical photos begin in high-contrast black-and-white duotone, instantly shift into warm vintage Kodachrome/lithographic color tones, and finally morph into a modern crisp hyper-realistic 3D render inside the diorama.

TYPOGRAPHY & SYMBOLS:
Large, bold 3D kinetic typography with mystical editorial serif custom letterforms (tarot aesthetic), textured in solid matte or gold-foil finish, casting realistic soft shadows on the diorama background. Text snaps into place on the beat with stop-motion timing.
